name: Sonic Melee
description: Sonic Melee lets you use the power of sound waves to damage your foes with devastating close range sonic attacks that can inflict Migraines, debuffing their resistance to multiple debuffs, and holding foes for a short duration. This can be dramatically increased by using Sound Booster. With the ability to Attune your frequency to your target's, your single target attacks can trigger powerful reverberating damage over time, helping you quickly bring enemies to their knees.

powers.name: Sonic Thrust
powers.description:
A focused attack of intense sonic power with high chance to violently knock a nearby foe off their feet. Deals minimal damage, but can be very effective.

When hitting Attuned targets, this power will briefly speed up and increase the damage of Attune.

powers.name: Strident Echo
powers.description:
Strident Echo deals minor damage over time. It has a low chance of causing a migraine, leaving the target shaking in pain and helpless.

When hitting Attuned targets, this power will briefly speed up and increase the damage of Attune.
powers.shortHelp: Melee, DMG(Energy/Smash), Foe -Res(Debuffs), Chance for Hold

powers.name: Attune
powers.description:
You focus high-intensity sound waves that match the resonant frequency of your targets with your single target Sonic Melee attacks. This power inflicts continuous damage over time as well as reducing the target's resistances to Damage and Debuffs. You can only Attune to a target for a brief time, needing constant tuning to maintain.

While Attune is active, all your other Sonic Melee attacks will also gain 10% more potency, enhancing their effects vs enemies.
powers.shortHelp: Melee Toggle, Foe DOT(Energy), Foe -Res(DMG, Debuffs), Special

powers.name: Sound Booster
powers.description: Greatly boosts your attacks for a few seconds. Slightly increases chance to hit. Moderately increases the duration of mez effects. Moderately increases the chance for Sound Manipulation powers to induce migraines.

powers.name: Sonic Clap
powers.description:
You generate a powerful sonic wave that damages foes in front of you with a decent chance to stun and knock them down.

This power will echo damage over time in a large area when hitting Attuned targets.

powers.name: Taunt
powers.description: Taunts a foe, and some nearby foes, to attack you. Useful for pulling villains off an ally who find themselves in over their head. Taunted foes tend to ignore other Heroes and focus on you for quite a while, so use this power cautiously. A To Hit check is required to Taunt enemy players, but is not needed against critter targets.

powers.name: Sandman's Whisper
powers.description:
You whisper in your foe's ear with a slumbering effect. Affected foe might fall asleep and will have their damage resistance lowered.

When hitting Attuned targets, this power will briefly speed up and increase the damage of Attune.

powers.name: Deafening Wave
powers.description:
You create a large field of sonic waves, causing damage to all foes around you. It has a moderate chance of causing migraines, leaving them shaking in pain and helpless.

This power will echo damage over time in a large area when hitting Attuned targets.
powers.shortHelp: PBAoE Melee, DMG(Energy/Smash), Foe Chance for Hold, -Res(Debuffs)

powers.name: Earsplitter
powers.description:
You generate an earsplitting sound wave right in the face of your foe, inflicting great damage. It has a good chance of causing a migraine, leaving them shaking in pain and helpless.

When hitting Attuned targets, this power will briefly speed up and increase the damage of Attune.
powers.shortHelp: Melee, DMG(Energy/Smash), Foe -Res(Debuffs), Chance for Hold
